pa_f_super_slab_sector.blurb: Super Slab Sector is one of the eleven stretches of cliff at Safe Harbor South, a bolted rail-bed crag a short way below the Safe Harbor Dam in south-central Pennsylvania. It holds twelve single-pitch lines, nearly all of them sport, plus one trad route. The grades lean friendly: most climbs sit at 5.9 or easier, with a couple of 5.4 to 5.5 warm-ups for newer leaders and only a line or two at 5.10 and up. That spread makes it a comfortable stop for a mixed party working through the grades. It sits between Machismo and Autumn Arch, so it is easy to combine with its neighbours in a day.
pa_f_super_slab_sector.parking_note: Leave the car just before or just after the tunnel on Green Hill Road. There is space for plenty of vehicles, but the road dead-ends, so plan a turnaround.
pa_f_super_slab_sector.approach: From the tunnel lot, a climbers' trail leads up to the old rail trail. Walk north along it; this sector is the fifth one you reach going that way, after Machismo and before Autumn Arch.

pa_little_fluffy_clouds_area.blurb: Little Fluffy Clouds Area is a small cluster of boulder problems along the Caves Trail on Haycock Mountain, in the Nockamixon part of southeastern Pennsylvania. About a dozen problems are recorded here, and the range is wide for such a compact spot: several easy problems at V0 to V2, a solid middle group around V4 to V5, and a few hard lines above that, topped by one very difficult V9. The namesake traverse is the best-known problem and a regular objective for visiting boulderers. Expect a wooded trailside setting rather than a roadside crag, and bring pads.
